title: Senior Automation Tester
description:
**Entity:**

Technology  

**Job Family Group:**

IT&S Group  

**Job Description:**

**Role Purpose**

  
  

The Senior Automation Tester is responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of digital products through robust test automation strategies. The role involves designing, developing, and maintaining scalable automation frameworks, integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines, and collaborating with multi-functional teams to deliver high-quality software at speed.

  
  

**Key skills**- **This role is more of system automation tester so hands on python / java and any testing tool like selenium along with other testing framework like cucumber etc, would be required.**

**Exp- 6+ years of relevant experience.**

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**

  
  

**Test Automation Strategy**

* Define and implement automation testing strategies across web, API, mobile, and backend applications.
* Design scalable, maintainable, and reusable automation frameworks.
* Drive automation coverage across functional, regression, integration, end-to-end, and smoke testing.

**Test Design & Execution**

* Review business requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Develop automated test scripts using industry-standard frameworks and tools.
* Implement automated and manual tests where required.
* Analyze test results and report defects with detailed root cause analysis.

**CI/CD & Quality Engineering**

* Integrate automated tests into Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or equivalent CI/CD pipelines.
* Define and maintain quality gates for deployments.
* Support shift-left testing practices and continuous testing.

**Collaboration & Leadership**

* Work closely with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Developers, Architects, and DevOps engineers.
* Mentor junior testers and automation engineers.
* Promote quality engineering best practices across teams.
* Participate in code reviews and test automation design reviews.

**Operational Completion**

* Supervise and improve test execution stability.
* Maintain test environments and test data.
* Track automation metrics, defect trends, and quality KPIs.
* Continuously improve framework performance and maintainability.
  

  

**Technical Skills**

  
  

**Required**

* 6+ years of validated experience in software testing, with at least 4+ years in automation.
* Strong experience with:
  + Selenium WebDriver / Playwright / Cypress
  + Java, C#, Python, or TypeScript
  + TestNG, JUnit, NUnit, or equivalent frameworks
  + BDD frameworks such as Cucumber/Gherkin
* API testing using Postman, Rest Assured, Karate, or similar tools.
* Experience with Azure DevOps, GitHub, Jenkins, or CI/CD platforms.
* Strong understanding of Agile and Scrum practices.
* SQL and database validation skills.

**Preferred**

* Cloud experience (AWS or Azure).
* Containerization knowledge (Docker/Kubernetes).
* Performance testing exposure (JMeter, LoadRunner, k6).
* Security testing awareness.
* Experience with microservices and event-driven architectures.
* ISTQB certification.
  

  

**Behavioral Competencies**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Proactive ownership and accountability.
* Excellent collaborator management and communication.
* Ability to influence engineering teams toward quality-first practices.
* Mentoring and coaching capability.
* Adaptability in fast-paced Agile environments.
  

  

**Key Deliverables**

* Automation framework development and maintenance.
* Regression suite automation coverage.
* CI/CD quality gate implementation.
* Defect prevention and early quality feedback.
* Test reporting dashboards and quality metrics.
* Reduction in manual testing effort and faster release cycles.
  

  

**Success Measures (KPIs)**

* Automation coverage (%)
* Regression execution time reduction
* Defect leakage rate
* Production defect reduction
* CI/CD pipeline pass rate
* Test execution stability
* Quality gate compliance
Release readiness and deployment success rate

Our purpose is to deliver energy to the world, today and tomorrow. For over 100 years, bp has focused on discovering, developing, and producing oil and gas in the nations where we operate. title: Manager, Quality Assurance
description:
**About Autonomize AI**
=======================

Autonomize AI is on a mission to help organizations make sense of the world's dark data. Unstructured data contains critical insights that, when paired with human context, unlock transformative business outcomes. Our goal is to make that process effortless and accessible.

We are an ambitious, global, remote team committed to human-machine collaboration. Our founders are serial entrepreneurs who have successfully scaled multiple venture-backed companies. We combine expertise in building cutting-edge data products, captivating user experiences, and scaling enterprise AI solutions.

### **The Opportunity**

We are seeking a seasoned, strategic **QA Manager** with **12+ years of experience** to build, scale, and govern our quality engineering and software release ecosystem.

In this dual-impact leadership role, you will define and execute the overall QA strategy while taking end-to-end ownership of delivery schedules, CI/CD release governance, and cross-functional release management. You will manage and mentor a team of high-performing SDETs and QA Engineers, ensuring our enterprise AI products are delivered predictably, securely, and with uncompromised quality.

### **What You’ll Do**

#### **Quality Engineering & Leadership**

* **Strategic QA Leadership:** Define, own, and execute the global QA vision, quality metrics (KPIs/OKRs), and long-term testing roadmap aligned with business objectives.
* **Team Governance & Mentorship:** Lead, mentor, and grow a high-caliber team of SDETs and QA engineers; drive continuous learning and establish engineering best practices.
* **Automation & ML Testing:** Oversee the architectural strategy for scalable, robust test automation frameworks (Web UI, API, Data Pipelines, and Machine Learning/AI model testing).
* **Enterprise Quality Assurance:** Drive shift-left testing methodologies, security/compliance validations, performance/load testing, and overall dark-data pipeline reliability.

#### **Delivery & Release Management**

* **End-to-End Release Management:** Own the release lifecycle for multi-tenant and enterprise AI deployments—managing release cadence, risk assessments, scope stability, and go/no-go decisions.
* **CI/CD Pipeline Governance:** Collaborate closely with DevOps and Engineering to integrate automated quality gates into CI/CD pipelines, enabling smooth, repeatable, zero-downtime deployments.
* **Cross-Functional Delivery Alignment:** Act as the central liaison between Engineering, Product Management, Customer Success, and Leadership to ensure delivery timelines are met without compromising quality.
* **Incident & Risk Management:** Establish post-release verification protocols, track production issues, lead root cause analyses (RCA), and implement preventive measures to continuously elevate delivery reliability.

### **You’re a Fit If You Have**

* **Experience:** **12+ years** of progressive experience in Software Quality Engineering, with **5+ years in a manager or leadership capacity**.
* **Release & Delivery Expertise:** Proven track record in release management, release governance, and orchestrating complex deployment cycles for enterprise SaaS/Cloud platforms.
* **Technical & Automation Mastery:** Deep expertise in building/architecting test automation frameworks using Python, Selenium, PyTest, Cypress, or similar tools, along with API testing (Postman, REST Assured).
* **AI/ML & Data Platform Exposure:** Demonstrated experience testing data-intensive applications, unstructured data processing pipelines, or Machine Learning/AI platforms.
* **CI/CD & DevOps Integration:** Hands-on familiarity with CI/CD tools (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins) and containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes).
* **Process & Agile Leadership:** Deep understanding of Agile/Scrum delivery models, test management systems (Jira, Xray/Zephyr), and tracking key quality metrics (Defect Escape Rate, Test Coverage, Release Cycle Time).
* **Communication & Executive Presence:** Outstanding stakeholder management, problem-solving skills, and the ability to articulate quality/release risks to technical and non-technical leaders alike.

### **What We Offer**

* **Influence & Impact:** Shape the core quality and delivery strategy for enterprise AI implementations.
* **Outsized Opportunity:** Join at an influential level in a rapidly scaling, VC-backed startup.
* **Ownership & Autonomy:** End-to-end ownership of QA and release processes with the freedom to innovate.
* **Learning & Growth:** Constant exposure to serial founders, cutting-edge AI technologies, and a dedicated professional development budget.

*Autonomize AI is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, or other legally protected statuses.*

title: Senior QA Engineer
description:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!

**Company Profile**
-------------------

Qualys is a leading provider of cloud-based security and compliance solutions, helping organizations identify vulnerabilities, manage cyber risk, and protect their IT infrastructure.

The **Module Loader is a critical component of Qualys Remote Vulnerability Detection and acts as the brain behind vulnerability assessment workflows**. It plays a key role in orchestrating and executing the capabilities required to identify vulnerabilities across diverse enterprise environments and technologies.

Given its central role in vulnerability detection, the Module Loader requires a high degree of **accuracy, reliability, scalability, performance, and backward compatibility**. The team works on complex engineering challenges involving vulnerability detection, networking, protocols, operating systems, security technologies, and large-scale enterprise environments.

Be part of the team building and validating one of the foundational components powering Qualys vulnerability detection.

**Core Responsibility**
-----------------------

As a **Senior Software QA Engineer**, you will be responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, performance, and scalability of the Module Loader and its remote vulnerability detection capabilities.

This is a **hands-on technical QA/SDET role** where you will own quality from requirements and design through release and production. You will work closely with developers, security researchers, Product Management, and other engineering teams to understand vulnerability detection requirements and translate them into comprehensive test strategies.

You will be expected to go beyond functional validation and understand **how vulnerability detection works**, identify potential gaps and edge cases, create complex test environments, automate validation, analyze failures, and troubleshoot problems across application, operating system, network, and protocol layers.

You will have end-to-end quality ownership of features, including **test design, automation, functional and integration testing, performance and scalability testing, regression qualification, debugging, and production issue analysis**.

### **Position Requirements**

Eligible candidates should meet the following criteria.

### **Required**

* 4+ years of hands-on experience in **Software QA, SDET, or Software Testing** for complex enterprise software products.
* Strong experience in testing **system-level, security, networking, or distributed applications**, preferably on Linux/Unix platforms.
* Strong hands-on experience with **test automation** using Python, Shell scripting, C/C++, or equivalent programming/scripting languages.
* Ability to independently understand complex feature requirements and technical designs and develop comprehensive **test strategies, test plans, test scenarios, and automation**.
* Strong understanding of **Linux/Unix operating systems**, processes, services, file systems, permissions, package management, and system-level troubleshooting.
* Strong knowledge of **networking fundamentals and protocols**, including TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, SSL/TLS, proxies, and client-server communication.
* Strong debugging and problem-solving skills with the ability to investigate failures across **application, operating system, and network layers**.
* Experience analyzing logs, network traffic, system behavior, application failures, CPU/memory utilization, and other diagnostic information to drive issues toward root cause.
* Experience in **functional, integration, regression, negative, compatibility, upgrade, and end-to-end testing**.
* Ability to identify corner cases, failure scenarios, environmental dependencies, and regression risks beyond documented requirements.
* Experience validating software across heterogeneous enterprise environments involving different **operating systems, services, network configurations, and software versions**.
* Experience with **performance, scalability, reliability, and resiliency testing** of enterprise products.
* Strong focus on an **automation-first approach**, with experience building maintainable and reusable automated tests and reducing repetitive manual validation.
* Experience integrating automation into **CI/CD pipelines** and analyzing failures to differentiate product defects, automation failures, and environmental issues.
* Strong understanding of **SDLC/STLC, defect lifecycle, risk-based testing, release qualification, source control, and software engineering best practices**.
* Ability to work independently with developers and other engineering teams to reproduce, debug, and drive complex product issues to closure.
* Strong analytical mindset with the ability to question assumptions and identify scenarios where expected vulnerability detection behavior may produce **incorrect, incomplete, inconsistent, or unexpected results**.
* Self-driven and quick learner with an interest in understanding new technologies, operating systems, protocols, applications, and security concepts.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to engage with different technical teams, seek clarification, challenge assumptions constructively, and build consensus.

**Desirable Requirements**
--------------------------

* Experience in the **Cyber Security, Vulnerability Management, Vulnerability Assessment, or Network Security** domain.
* Understanding of vulnerability detection concepts and security assessment methodologies.
* Experience testing **network scanners, vulnerability scanners, security products, or other network-intensive system software**.
* Good knowledge of common enterprise protocols and services.
* Knowledge of **SSL/TLS, certificates, authentication mechanisms, and cryptography fundamentals**.
* Experience with packet analysis and network troubleshooting tools such as **Wireshark/tcpdump** or equivalent tools.
* Exposure to C/C++ applications and debugging tools such as **GDB**.
* Experience creating and maintaining complex test environments consisting of multiple operating systems, applications, services, and network configurations.
* Exposure to **containers, virtualization, and cloud infrastructure**.
* Experience developing or enhancing **QA automation frameworks, test infrastructure, or large-scale test environments**.

### **Basic Qualifications**

Bachelor's / Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline (M.E / M.Tech, B.E / B.Tech, MCA) and **4 to 6 years of relevant experience** as a Senior Software QA Engineer, Software QA Engineer, SDET, Automation Engineer, Software Test Engineer, or a similar technical quality engineering role.

title: Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
**INSPIRE | EXHILARATE | DELIGHT**

Chalhoub Group’s Capability Hub is our technology and innovation hub set up with the vision to unite exceptional talent to build technology and capabilities that elevate luxury experiences and define the future of luxury retail.

For over seven decades, Chalhoub Group has been a partner and creator of luxury experiences in the Middle East. In its pursuit to excel as a hybrid luxury retailer, the Group has curated a portfolio of over 10 owned brands and strengthened its distribution and marketing expertise for over 400 international names across luxury fashion, beauty, jewellery, watches, eyewear, and art de vivre categories.

Every step at Chalhoub Group is taken to build a future where luxury dreams become reality — bridging cultures and crafting memorable experiences for our consumers. Be it by constantly reinventing itself, committing to innovation, or embracing new technologies, the Group is shaping the future of luxury retail. It delivers seamless omnichannel experiences across more than 950 stores, online platforms, and mobile apps. Driving this innovation journey is The Greenhouse — the Group’s innovation hub, incubator, and accelerator for startups and emerging businesses, regionally and globally.

Chalhoub Group fosters a people-at-heart culture rooted in diversity, equity, and inclusion, and a workplace catalysed by forward thinking and futureproofing. Today, it brings together over 16,000 talented professionals across eight countries in the Middle East, with a presence in LATAM.

Sustainability is at the core of the Group’s strategy, guided by a clear commitment to people, partners, and the planet. Chalhoub Group is proud to be a member of the United Nations Global Compact, a signatory of the Women’s Empowerment Principles, and to have pledged to reach Net Zero by 2040.

**What you'll be doing**

Work fully hands-on to plan, design, execute, and document testing across functional, integration, end-to-end, and regression cycles, validating software releases against business requirements and integrations, and owning the quality of assigned work.

* Plan, design, execute, and document functional, integration, end-to-end, and regression testing for assigned scope.
* Analyze requirements and validate acceptance criteria, identifying risks and defects early through risk-based and exploratory testing.
* Prepare and maintain test data, test environments, and execution evidence so release validation can proceed without avoidable delay.
* Perform API testing and web and mobile testing and prepare test data to ensure effective test coverage.
* Identify, report, and manage defects with clear reproduction steps, and perform timely retesting through to closure.
* Own reliable release validation for assigned work, ensuring committed scope is delivered on time with the required quality.
* Support UAT and launch readiness by coordinating defect triage, retesting, and sign off with product and business stakeholders.
* Support Agile delivery through delivery planning, estimation, and prioritization, and collaborate with engineers and product teams.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of testing, using AI-assisted test case generation to accelerate coverage while maintaining quality standards.

**What you’ll need to succeed**

* Minimum 3 years of hands-on software testing experience across functional, integration, end-to-end, and regression testing.
* Strong test case design, requirements analysis, acceptance criteria validation, and defect identification and management skills.
* Hands-on experience with API testing, web and mobile testing, test data preparation, and risk-based testing.
* Working knowledge of QA methodologies, Agile delivery, and release validation, with a strong quality ownership mindset.
* Familiarity with AI-assisted test case generation tools to support test coverage.
* Experience testing ecommerce or omnichannel customer journeys, APIs, web and mobile experiences, and integrations in an Agile release cadence.

**What we can offer you**

With us, you will turn your aspirations into reality. title: Lead Support Analyst
description:
**About Kaseya**

Kaseya is the leading provider of AI-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. Our comprehensive platform helps organizations efficiently manage, secure, and automate their IT environments, driving operational efficiency and long-term business success.

Backed by Insight Partners, a leading global software investor, Kaseya has experienced sustained double-digit growth and continues to expand its global footprint. Today, Kaseya supports customers in more than 20 countries and manages over 15 million endpoints worldwide.

Founded in 2000, Kaseya was built by builders - and we're still building. We look for people who create rather than wait, who see a hard problem and lean in, and who treat challenges as raw material. At Kaseya, everyone plays a role in shaping the future of IT: whether you're in engineering, product, sales, marketing, customer support, or operations, your work helps protect, defend, and optimize IT environments across the globe.

We're building teams that grow, perform, and make an impact. If you're driven by the itch to make things better - a product, a process, a career - you'll fit right in.

At Kaseya, we don't just raise the bar. We build it.

**Position Summary**

Kaseya is seeking an experienced Lead Support Analyst – Release Managementto support and coordinate release management activities for enterprise business applications, including Oracle, Salesforce, and other supported platforms. The role involves planning, coordinating, and supporting release events, ensuring compliance with established processes, approvals, testing requirements, and deployment procedures.

The position will provide IST-based release coverage, complementing EST Release Management operations to ensure seamless global release support, effective stakeholder communication, and business continuity. The ideal candidate will have strong technical and operational expertise, excellent coordination skills, and a continuous improvement mindset.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Support the planning, coordination, and execution of release events for enterprise applications in collaboration with IT, Engineering, QA, and business stakeholders.
* Coordinate release documentation and ensure required testing results and validation evidence are available before deployment.
* Track release approvals and verify that all readiness criteria are met before releases proceed within approved deployment windows.
* Support release-related incident coordination, engage appropriate technical teams, and escalate risks or issues to minimize business impact.
* Participate in post-release reviews, document lessons learned, and recommend improvements to release processes.
* Communicate release status, risks, issues, and outcomes clearly to relevant stakeholders.
* Maintain release management documentation, procedures, and operational records in accordance with established standards.
* Monitor release metrics and operational data to support performance tracking and service level expectations.
* Provide IST release coverage and ensure structured handoffs with EST Release Management to maintain continuity of global release operations.
* Identify opportunities to improve release processes, operational efficiency, and compliance with established release management practices.

**Preferred Qualification**

* Experience supporting enterprise applications such as Oracle, Salesforce, and other business-critical platforms.
* Familiarity with release management methodologies, deployment coordination, change management, and release governance practices.
* Experience working with global teams across different time zones, particularly IST and EST.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and incident coordination skills.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and cross-functional collaboration abilities.
* Experience maintaining release documentation, tracking operational metrics, and supporting process improvement initiatives.
* Ability to work independently, demonstrate operational ownership, and adapt to a fast-paced environment.
* Customer-focused approach with strong attention to detail, accountability, and commitment to service excellence.

**Required Qualification**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Management, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5+ years of experience in release management or enterprise application support.
* Hands-on involvement in large-scale deployment activities and release execution support.
* Strong technical proficiency in enterprise business applications and release management methodologies.
* Experience collaborating with global, remote IT and business teams.
* Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain technical information to diverse audiences and coordinate with multiple stakeholders.
* Ability to work independently during IST hours while maintaining effective coordination with global teams.
* Flexibility to work shifts aligned with global business requirements and participate in on-call support as needed.
* Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage release activities, identify risks and support timely issue resolution.

**Additional information**

title: QA Engineer (Playwright)
description:
**QA Engineer (Playwright)**


In our ENOVIA India organization, we are looking for a strongly motivated QA Engineer who will have a fundamental role in enabling business and industry innovators to collaboratively build and execute a successful plan, transforming market opportunities into marketplace advantages. As a Software Test Engineer, you will be participating in Qualification of Web and/or Client\-Server Applications. These Applications are used by our customers to design, develop, produce and market their Products and/or Services to end consumers. You will work directly with Product Define, Development, Testing, Project Management teams to ensure we are delivering high\-quality, innovative products with an emphasis on speed to market and sustainability. You will lead in execution and team adoption of testing, automation tools \& best practices.

**Role description \& responsibilities**

* Build, maintain, and scale automated E2E tests using Playwright and TypeScript
* Work closely with cross\-functional teams to ensure project compliance with SQA standards and overall deliverable quality.
* Partner with Product and Engineering to translate intricate financial/regulatory rules into robust test scenarios.
* Integrate test suites into CI/CD pipelines for frequent, reliable releases
* Work with remote teams in an agile environment.
* Investigate failed test cases/ automated scripts and report issues in defect tracking system, and provide Defect and Product metrics to QA Manager as appropriate.
* Collaborate closely with developers to troubleshoot and isolate complex defects
 **Qualifications**

* BE/BTech/ME/MTech professional who has 5\+ years of experience in Automation Testing of Software Applications involved in development and execution of functional, integration \& regression tests of both Web and Client\-Server Applications.
* Strong proficiency in TypeScript and Playwright
* Automation Testing of Web Services/APIs’ \& good understanding of its Automation Framework.
* Should have the motivation and ability to learn new Tools (including in\-house ones), and Processes in order to deliver global objectives.
* Good Knowledge of SDLC/STLC Processes and Tools.
* High interest in, or prior experience with, complex functional domains (Finance, Banking, or RegTech).
* Experience of working with AI (testing AI features or utilizing AI tools for QA) would be an added advantage
* Knowledge/Experience of working in a DevOps Environment would be an added advantage.
* Experience of Automation on CLOUD and Mobile would be an added advantage.
* Ability to communicate well, work as part of a team and interact effectively with others.
* Displays initiative, self\-motivation, and effective time\-management skills.

**What’s in it for you**

* Work in a culture of collaboration and innovation
* Be at the forefront of building software products that are being deployed in mission\-critical projects world wide
* Be offered avenues to develop yourself for career progression
* Not a low\-level development opportunity, as you would get to work in the real business world and with a wide range of customers \& coworkers
* Work on a variety of technologies, products and solutions

-----------------------

We believe that our people are our number one asset and we want all employees to feel empowered to bring their whole selves to work every day.
